headline_item.title_zh: 数学界证实勒文·阿尔伯格完成黎曼猜想形式化证明
headline_item.title_en: A joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities says "we have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct" (Lean community blog)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 数学家勒文·阿尔伯格通过1700万行Lean代码完成黎曼猜想证明，并获Lean与Mathlib社区官方认证
headline_item.event_summary_en: Mathematician Levent Alpöge released a formal proof of the Riemann Hypothesis on November 20, 2026, consisting of 17 million lines of Lean code relying on the Mathlib library. The Lean and Mathlib communities have officially certified the proof's correctness after comprehensive verification of its logic and codebase.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】数学家勒文·阿尔伯格；Lean与Mathlib社区；Lean FRO在Lean与Mathlib社区官方博客：完成黎曼猜想的形式化证明，包含1700万行代码，并获得社区技术合规认证
【起因与机理】利用交互式定理证明器消除传统数学证明中的复杂性与人工错误，推动计算数学范式变革
【关键数据与实测】关键细节：包含1700万行Lean代码的黎曼猜想证明，通过了严苛的四项形式化合规审查。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：形式化证明成为数学研究的新标准，将重塑纯数学研究的验证流程。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Levent Alpöge; Lean and Mathlib communities; Lean FRO (Lean and Mathlib community blog): Completed a formal proof of the Riemann Hypothesis via 17 million lines of code, certified by the community
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Leveraging interactive theorem provers to eliminate complexity and human error in traditional proofs
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Formal proofs become the new standard, reshaping verification workflows in pure mathematics.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此次证明标志着“形式化数学”从学术边缘走向核心，证明了超大规模计算验证复杂猜想的可行性。该事件将极大加速数学定理验证的自动化进程，并为AI辅助科学发现提供了高置信度的底层范式。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This milestone marks the transition of 'formal mathematics' from the academic periphery to the core, validating the feasibility of using massive-scale computation to resolve complex conjectures. It will accelerate the automation of theorem verification and establish a high-confidence paradigm for AI-driven scientific discovery.

headlines.title_zh: AI服务器供应吃紧，供应商违约提价达45%
headlines.title_en: Tech suppliers raise AI server prices up to 45% months after deals are signed
headlines.event_summary_zh: 受AI基础设施需求激增驱动，部分供应商在签署供货协议后将服务器价格调涨高达45%
headlines.event_summary_en: Global data center equipment suppliers are significantly increasing prices for previously contracted AI servers, with hikes reaching up to 45%. This surge is driven by extreme supply-demand imbalances in AI infrastructure, forcing manufacturers to bypass existing contract terms to pass on rising memory and component costs.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】数据中心设备供应商；Nvidia系AI服务器买方在全球数据中心硬件供应链：在合同签订后强行将AI服务器售价上调至多45%
【起因与机理】AI算力基建需求暴增，内存等上游元器件供给短缺，导致供应商利润空间被挤压
【关键数据与实测】合同签订后执行45%的提价，供应链议价逻辑发生剧变。
【行业影响与走向】市场影响：算力采购从财务预算驱动转向紧迫的供应保障驱动。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Data center equipment suppliers; Buyers of Nvidia-powered AI servers: Unilaterally increasing AI server prices by up to 45% post-contract
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Explosive demand for AI compute infrastructure and upstream memory shortages squeezing supplier margins
[Key Metrics] 45% price hike post-contract, shift in supply chain bargaining power.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Market impact: Transition from budget-driven to supply-security-driven compute procurement.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 该现象暴露出AI硬件市场的卖方市场格局已具备极强的价格垄断属性，传统合同履约信誉在极端供需压力下正面临重构。对于算力需求方而言，供应链稳定性风险已取代采购成本成为制约业务扩容的首要因素。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This trend reveals a robust seller's market in the AI hardware sector, where traditional contract enforcement is fracturing under extreme supply-demand pressures. For compute buyers, supply chain stability risks have now superseded procurement costs as the primary constraint on business scaling.

headlines.title_zh: 新加坡华裔李明涉嫌向中国违规出口英伟达芯片
headlines.title_en: The Alice Huang Associate Accused of Funneling Nvidia Chips to China
headlines.event_summary_zh: 新加坡警方逮捕并保释涉嫌运营贸易网络、非法向中国走私英伟达AI芯片的关键人物李明
headlines.event_summary_en: Li Ming, a 52-year-old Chinese national based in Singapore, is accused of operating a smuggling network that funneled restricted Nvidia AI chips to China by utilizing front companies including Megaspeed. Li is currently out on bail, having played a central role in orchestrating the bypass of U.S. export controls.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】李明（涉案贸易商）、Megaspeed（涉案新加坡贸易公司）在新加坡：通过多层贸易网络将受限AI芯片违规出口至中国
【起因与机理】规避美国商务部针对中国高性能计算集群的严苛出口许可审查
【调查与监管诉求】核心涉案：李明被指控作为幕后主谋通过新加坡公司向中国非法供货。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：新加坡监管机构加强对高科技贸易实体的合规审计与跨境物流追踪。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Li Ming (trader), Megaspeed (Singapore-based trading firm) (Singapore): Illicit export of restricted AI chips to China via complex supply chain networks
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To circumvent U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) export licensing requirements
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Core Allegation: Li Ming accused of orchestrating illegal Nvidia chip exports to China.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Singaporean authorities expected to tighten compliance audits on high-tech trade intermediaries.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 该案揭示了出口管制政策下，利用离岸贸易中心（如新加坡）作为货物流转节点的洗白路径正在遭受严厉监管排查。芯片走私链条的精密化迫使供应链透明度合规义务从一级渠道商延伸至二级代理，未来英伟达的区域分销合规性审查将面临更严苛的审计成本压力。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This case highlights the growing reliance on offshore trading hubs to bypass export controls and suggests a shift toward more rigorous end-user verification requirements. As supply chain opacity becomes a primary regulatory target, Nvidia must significantly heighten its audit burden for regional distributors to mitigate secondary sanctions risk.

titans.quote_zh:
有没有注意到人工智能代理是如何过于字面地遵循你的指令的。

这就是为什么我一直在研究 @FensoryApp 如何处理在我看来真正重要的部分。

这些限制不仅仅是您在聊天中告诉客服人员的事情。

您可以设置每个订单可以交易的最大规模的市场，并且这些规则位于帐户中。

然后，每个订单在达到超流动性之前都会受到检查。

因此，如果限额为 100 美元，代理不能突然决定 101 美元就可以了，哈哈。

titans.quote_en:
Ever notice how an ai agent can follow your instructions a little too literally.

https://t.co/nzjQQj85UT

That is why i have been looking at how @FensoryApp handles the part that actually matters imo.

The limits are not just something you tell the agent in chat.

You set the markets it can trade the max size for each order and those rules sit on the account.

Then every order gets checked before it reaches hyperliquid.

So if the limit is $100 the agent can not suddenly decide $101 is fine lol.

The interesting part for me is that the agent still gets room to make its own decisions.

It can choose the strategy and execute trades but the account rules stay outside its control.

One thing i did probably add though.

A per order cap does not really tell you how much damage can happen across a whole day.

I did want a daily loss limit too especially if the strategy keeps running while i am not watching.

Because giving an agent permission to trade is one thing.

Deciding exactly how far that permission goes is another.

If you were setting up an agent on @FensoryApp would you care more about a max order size or a daily loss limit?

titans.quote_en:
An autonomous AI agent still depending on someone else's cloud subscription feels like a missing piece.

@Acurast has an interesting approach through its Deploy Agent.

Instead of requiring a developer account or an $ACU balance, an agent can pay for compute using USDC on Base through x402.

The process is fairly straightforward:

➛ Request compute through the Deploy Agent
➛ Pay using USDC
➛ Run the workload on Acurast infrastructure
No traditional cloud signup required.
That's a useful distinction for agents expected to operate independently.

The next question is whether the execution cost and reliability can compete with conventional hosting.
